_about: Synthetic example tree (simSOMA, vafSOMA_inputs/examples/example_tree): three branch tips with three leaves each, bulk leaf samples (L1 0.13, L2 0.84, L3 0.03), mean depth 60x. Per-organ model: every leaf is fitted and called separately. Expect L1 and L3 to be flagged unresolvable (14_layer_resolvability.csv). Settings reduced for a quick run (8 EM starts); use the defaults for real data.
